rules.effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock **^^Blood Tithe^^** abilities. You can only use **^^Blood Tithe^^** abilities that are unlocked. Once a **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.

Pick a **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability. That **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn

rules.effect: Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that **^^Charge^^** ability after that ability is resolved.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Charge^^** ability.

rules.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy **^^Wizards^^** or **^^Priests^^** within 6" of any friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units to be the target(s).
rules.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn

rules.declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy **^^Manifestation^^** that is not in combat is a target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase

rules.declare: Pick up to 4 enemy **^^Manifestations^^** to be the target(s).
rules.effect: Make a **banishment roll** of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that **^^Manifestation^^**'s warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is **banished** and removed from play.
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units.
Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit have no effect.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units that charged in the same turn.
Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units.
rules.nom: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne

rules.effect: This unit can use **^^Unbind^^** abilities as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

rules.declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets.
rules.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy **^^Heroes^^** while they are in combat with this unit.

Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Cavalry^^** or **^^Monster^^** units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.

Pick a friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Daemon^^** unit

rules.effect: Each friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Daemon^^** unit that has used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Bloodbound^^** unit and a friendly non-**^^Hero Blades of Khorne Daemon^^** unit to be the targets.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets' combat attacks.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Bloodbound Hero^^** and up to 2 other friendly ^^**Bloodbound^^** units that are wholly within 12" of that **^^Hero^^** to be the targets.
rules.effect: Add 2" to the targets' Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

rules.effect:
Subtract 1 from casting rolls for **^^Wizards^^** while they are within 12" of this unit.
Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy **^^Priests^^** while they are within 12" of this unit.

If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **^^Hero^^** by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy **^^Hero^^** has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit within this unit's combat range that is not in combat to be the target.
rules.effect: The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit's combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bleeding Icon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Bleeding Icon** wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation has 2 parts that must be set up within 8" of each other.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wrath-axe** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Wrath-axe** wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with the target, your opponent cannot spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability.
• If the target is destroyed, you gain 1 rage dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, you gain 2 rage dice instead.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a **^^Move^^** or **^^Fight^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect:
If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• The targets cannot use **^^Retreat^^** or **^^Run^^** abilities.
• The targets cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow them to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability (see 'Battle Traits') apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of 'Wild-eyed Brutality' on the target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll as 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **^^Ward (3+)^^** against damage inflicted by **^^Spell^^** abilities, **^^Prayer^^** abilities, and abilities used by **^^Manifestations^^** (including **^^Fight^^** abilities). If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a **^^Move^^**, **^^Charge^^**, or **^^Fight^^** ability, after that ability is resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.
Unmodified save rolls of 5+ for this unit cannot fail.

Each time this unit is picked to use the 'Eruption of Fury' ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for the attacks made as part of that ability, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• If the target unit's starting size was 1, subtract 1 from wound rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare:
Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar ^^** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.
rules.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.
**Designer's Note:** *'Unit type' refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. 'Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal' or 'Cannonade Cogfort'.*

rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** to use this ability.
rules.effect: Pick 1 of that unit's ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

rules.effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for a unit that is **under orders**

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hero^^** that is **under orders** to use this ability. That unit is the **field officer** for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non-**^^Hero^^** units that are **under orders** and wholly within 12" of the **field officer** to be the targets.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the **field officer** uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, you can pick a target that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn. That target is **inspirited** and the other target is **emboldened**.The **inspirited** target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by the **field officer** has been resolved. Then, if the **emboldened** target has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn, it can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **inspirited** target's **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.
rules.timing: One Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

rules.effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit's non-**Companion** melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon's Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.
Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** or **^^Prayer^^** ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**

rules.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Infantry^^** or ^^**Cavalry Hero^^** that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.
rules.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use **^^Move^^** abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).
Each time a friendly unit that is **under orders** uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly **^^Wizards^^** that are **under orders**.
**Designer's Note:** *Wizards in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.*
For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Sigmarite^^** units that target the enemy unit using that **^^Fight^^** ability.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Your opponent declared a **^^Fight^^** ability.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Cities of Sigmar Infantry^^** unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.
rules.effect:
If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Ironweld Great Cannon** units to be the targets.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Human Infantry Hero^^** to use this ability. Then, you can pick up to 1 friendly non-**^^Hero Human Infantry^^** unit and up to 1 friendly **^^Human War Machine^^** unit that are wholly within 12" of that **^^Hero^^** to be the targets.
rules.effect: While the targets are wholly within 12" of that **^^Hero^^**, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target **^^Infantry^^** unit's melee weapons and the target **^^War Machine^^** unit's ranged weapons until the start of your next turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Aelf^^** units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Duardin^^** units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.
rules.nom: I've Seen Worse and Killed Batter
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase

rules.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.
Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.
Other visible friendly units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit is **^^Human^^**, pick up to 3 eligible units to be the targets instead.
rules.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is **^^Human^^**, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.
• If the target is **^^Duardin^^**, add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• If the target is **^^Aelf^^**, add 3 to the target's control score.

rules.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Human^^** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target and add 2 to run rolls for the target.

Each time you pick targets while declaring a **^^Prayer^^** ability used by a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Priest^^**, if this unit is eligible to be picked, you can pick it to be an additional target

Spend any number of rage dice. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll **X** dice, where **X** is the number of rage dice spent. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the charge roll.
rules.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for a visible unit within 12" of this unit

rules.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non‑**^^War Machine Sigmarite^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
rules.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice** for each target. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to wound rolls for each target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an **^^Attack^^** ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that **^^Attack^^** ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after that **^^Attack^^** ability has been resolved.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-**^^War Machine Cities of Sigmar^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

For the rest of the turn:
• Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic
• This unit can use **^^Shoot^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.
• No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.
rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

rules.effect: Remove 1 of this unit's **heat tokens**.

rules.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
rules.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Combat Phase

rules.effect: While this unit has any champions, add 5 to this unit's control score.
While this unit has any champions, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

While this unit has any champions, if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the 'Eruption of Fury' ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit.

You perform a blood rite each time:
• An enemy unit is destroyed and any damage points were allocated to that unit by a friendly **anointed** unit's combat attacks in the same turn.
• A friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed.
• A friendly unit contesting an objective you control is destroyed.
• An enemy unit is destroyed by a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit's attacks and any models in that enemy unit were contesting an objective you do not control in the same phase.
• A unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed and it was within 3" of a **Place of Power** at the start of the phase.
Only one blood rite can be performed per unit destroyed.

rules.declare: If there are no friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-Unique **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** Hero on the battlefield to be the target.
rules.effect: The target is **anointed** for the rest of the battle, even if it has been destroyed. Friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield treat **^^Exalted^^** abilities on the warscrolls of friendly **anointed** units that have been destroyed as if they were on their warscroll.
Each time a friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed, after removing it from play, you can immediately use the 'Anointed Ritualist' ability as if it were the start of the first battle round.

Pick a friendly non-**Hero** **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of that **anointed** unit and has not charged this turn to be the target. If that **anointed** unit charges, after that **^^Charge^^** ability has been resolved, the target can immediately use the 'Charge' ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Charge ability for an anointed unit

rules.declare: You can only use this ability if you performed any blood rites this turn.
rules.effect:
Pick 1 of the following blessings that is not **active**. That blessing is **active**. While a blessing is **active**, its effect applies to friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** units. The effects of more than 1 blessing can apply to a unit at the same time.
•  **Blessing of Ruthlessness**: Add 1 to hit rolls for those units' combat attacks.
•  **Blessing of Hatred**: Add 1 to wound rolls for those units' combat attacks.
•  **Blessing of Haste**: Add 3" to those units' Move characteristic.
•  **Blessing of Zeal**: If those units charged in the same turn, they have **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.
•  **Blessing of Shadow**: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target those units.
•  **Blessing of Cruelty**: Those units can use **^^Charge^^** and/or **^^Shoot^^** abilities even if they have used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.
•  **Blessing of Clarity**: Add 1 to chanting rolls and casting rolls for those units.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

rules.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.

rules.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

rules.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**^^Unique Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
Return D3 slain models to each friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Aelf Infantry^^** unit.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

rules.effect: For the rest of the phase, friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Aelf Infantry^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** until they have used a **^^Fight^^** ability
While each model in a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** on the battlefield to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from castitng rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Enemy Turn

rules.effect: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Daughters of Khaine^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within that **anointed** unit's combat range to the the target. The target  can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by that **anointed** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn. If the melee weapons already have **Crit (Auto-wound)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn instead.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for an anointed unit

rules.declare: Pick each friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit contesting an objective to be the targets.
rules.effect:
Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2.
Return up to 1 slain model to each target that that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

rules.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit

rules.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. If the target is destroyed by this ability, this unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-Last^^** for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability, all of the target's attacks must target this unit.

Apply the effect below instead of the effect of that 'Activate Place of Power' ability. 
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. On a 2+, if there are no friendly **Avatars of Khaine** on the battlefield, set up an **Avatar of Khaine** wholly within 12" of this unit, visible to it and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit has summoned that **^^Manifestation^^**.
rules.timing: Reaction: This unit used the 'Activate Place of Power' ability

rules.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Hero^^** that has a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit's Health characteristic to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the battle, if this unit is within the target's combat range when the target would be destroyed, the target is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** the target. Then, this unit is destroyed.
If this unit is anointed, the effect of all blessings from the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability apply to this unit as if they were active.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bladewind** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Daughters Of Khaine Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Bladewind** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bloodwrack Viper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Bloodwrack Viper** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Heart of Fury** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Heart of Fury** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Add 10 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: The target's melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 7+, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-**^^Unique Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In
addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, the target can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **^^Strike-Last^^** for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Aelf Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Aelf Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target of this ability instead.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Aelf Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this prayer this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: The target can move up to 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Aelf Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks. In addition, if the chanting roll was 9+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: The target can use **^^Charge^^** abilities this turn even if it used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: The target's melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)** until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them, pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that point to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: The targets cannot use **^^Run^^** abilities until the start of your next turn.
Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to that casting roll, chanting roll or unbinding roll.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^**, **^^Prayer^^** or **^^Unbind^^** ability for a unit within 3" of this unit

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• The target cannot use **^^Retreat^^** abilities.
• If an ability would heal or return any slain models to the target unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**^^Monster Disciples of Tzeentch^^** units to be the targets.
rules.effect:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up in reserve **masked by illusion**.
Friendly units that are **masked by illusion** are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.

You start the battle with 0 **fate points**, Gain 1 **fate point** each time:
• You lose the priority toll.
• A spell cast by a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit is unbound.
• A friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit miscasts a spell.
• Your opponent gains control of an objective that you controlled at the start of the turn.
• A friendly **Argent Shard** is **demolished**.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Monster Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit that was not set up this turn and was not set up using this ability in the previous turn to be the target, then pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the substitute.
rules.effect: Set up the substitute wholly within 6" of the target and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set up in reserve **masked by illusion**.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase

rules.effect:
If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
**Designer's Note**: *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

Before allocating damage points to a friendly **Disciples of Tzeentch** unit, you can spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, remove 1 damage point in that unit's damage pool.
Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the casting roll for that spell.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit

rules.effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the charge roll for that **^^Charge^^** ability.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for a **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit in your turn

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while those friendly units are wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit that was set up in the same turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Roll either 5 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of **fate points** you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6
rules.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then you can pick a friendly non-**^^Monster Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect:
Set the target up in reserve **masked by illusion**. Then, you can pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** and set it up wholly within 12" of the caster or a friendly **Argent Shard** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
**Designer's Note**: *Both parts of the effect are optional; you can carry out either part or both.*

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain by this ability, you can pick a friendly **Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch** unit that is **masked by illusion** and set it up on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.
Change the casting roll for that spell to a value of 12 that cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound and this unit cannot use that **^^Spell^^** ability again for the rest of the battle.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a non-**^^Summon^^** **^^Spell^^** ability for this unit

rules.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, roll a dice. If the roll is the same as any of the dice in the casting roll, that spell is miscast. Otherwise, add the roll to the casting roll.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit

rules.effect: This unit has a Move characteristic of 14" and has **^^Fly^^**.
Add 1 to or subtract 1 form the casting roll for that spell. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **^^Spell^^** ability.
rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit wholly within 6" of this unit

rules.effect: Gain 1 **fate point** if any models were slain by this unit this turn.
Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.

rules.declare: Pick a visible **^^Manifestation^^** (friendly or enemy) that was not set up this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target is banished.
• **Heal (X)** this unit, where X is the target's Health characteristic.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

rules.effect: Pick 1 of this unit's melee weapons. That weapon's Attacks characteristic is 2D6 for the rest of the battle.

rules.declare: This unit can use this ability if any enemy **^^Manifestations^^** were banished this phase.
rules.effect: This unit can use a **^^Summon^^** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition. That **^^Summon^^** ability does not count towards the total number of **^^Spell^^** or **^^Banish^^** abilities this unit can use this phase.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

rules.effect: If you make a charge roll of 9+ for a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) to be the target.
rules.effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, gain 1 **fate point**.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn

rules.effect:
Each time a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit uses an ability that requires you to spend 1 or more **fate points**, after that ability has been resoled, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.
If you remove 1 or more damage points from the damage pool of a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit as a result of the 'Destined to Serve' ability, after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.
rules.effect: Set up the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

rules.effect: Friendly **^^Arcanite^^** units' melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Daemon^^** unit.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** that is in combat to be the target.
rules.effect: The target can use a non-**^^Summon Spell^^** ability as if it were your hero phase, but only the caster or enemy units in combat with the caster can be picked to be the targets of that **^^Spell^^** ability.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase

rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Warflock Arcanite^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
rules.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" away from all enemy units and wholly within 12" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is visible to this unit.
If this unit was set up this turn, it can move D3". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any damage points were allocated to the target this phase. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **^^Burning Sigil of Tzeentch^^** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **^^Burning Sigil of Tzeentch^^** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Daemonic Simulacrum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Daemonic Simulacrum** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Tome of Eyes** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Tome of Eyes** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

If you won the priority roll this battle round and chose for your opponent to take the first turn or if your opponent seized the initiative this battle round, this unit has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase

rules.effect:
If this unit is contesting an objective that you control that is wholly outside friendly territory:
• If you are the **underdog**, gain 1 **fate point** for each command point you have.
• If you are not the **underdog**, roll a dice for each command point you have. For each 3+, gain 1 **fate point**.
rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Your Turn

rules.effect:
While units (friendly or enemy) are within 6" of this unit:
• Add 1 to unbinding rolls for those units.
• Spells cast by those units are miscast on an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less.
The first time this unit is destroyed, gain D6 **fate points**.

rules.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^Abhorrants^^** to be the targets.
rules.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Abhorrant^^** to use this ability, then pick a friendly **^^Serfs^^** or **^^Knights^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
rules.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army) Your Movement Phase

rules.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^Nobles^^** to be the targets.
rules.effect:
For each target, pick 1 of the following:
• Return up to 3 slain models to a friendly **^^Serfs^^** unit wholly within 12" of it.
• Return 1 slain model to a friendly **^^Knights^^** unit wholly within 12" of it.
The same unit cannot have models returned to it by this ability more than once per turn.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Hero^^** in combat to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.
rules.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase

rules.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each turn. If it is the first turn of the battle, pick a **^^Delusion^^** from these battle traits or, unless otherwise specified, from the warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield. If it is not the first turn, make a delusion roll of D6.
rules.effect: On a delusion roll of 1-2, you must pick a different **^^Delusion^^** to the one you picked last turn. On a 3-4, you must pick the same **^^Delusion^^** as the one you picked last turn, even if it is on the warscroll of a unit that has been destroyed. In such cases, the effect of that **^^Delusion^^** applies as if the unit had not been destroyed. On a 5-6, you must pick a **^^Delusion^^** like you did in the first turn. For the rest of the turn, you believe the **^^Delusion^^** you picked.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn

rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Each time the target uses a **^^Charge^^** ability, if possible, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of this unit.
• While the target is in combat with this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's combat attacks that do not target this unit.

rules.declare: Pick an objective you do not control within 18" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, when resolving the damage sequence for enemy units contesting the target objective, your opponent cannot spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your fury level. Add 1 to each roll if this unit charged this turn. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

If this unit is not a **^^Priest^^**, it has **^^Priest (1)^^**. If this unit is already a **^^Priest^^**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit. If this unit is a Wizard, it cannot use **^^Spell^^** abilities and **^^Prayer^^** abilities in the same phase.

rules.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
rules.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the target's control characteristic or is a 6, the following effects apply for the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's combat attacks.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that target that enemy unit.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect:
Roll a D3: On a 2+, pick 1 of the following:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.
• If the target is a **^^Manifestation^^**, it is banished and removed from play.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. You can also pick a friendly **^^Serfs^^** unit within 6" of the target to be the raised ranks. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each damage point allocated to the target by this ability, you can return 1 slain model to the raised ranks.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

While a friendly non-**^^Hero Flesh-eater Courts Monster^^** or **^^Beast^^** is wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Heroes^^**:
• That non-**^^Hero^^** can use a **^^Rampage^^** ability on its warscroll even if that ability has already been used by another friendly **^^Monster^^** in the same turn.
• If that non-**^^Hero^^** unit charged in the same turn and the unmodified charge roll was 9+, it has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.
Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Knights^^** that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Heroes^^**.

rules.declare: Pick each friendly **^^Serfs^^** unit in combat to be the targets.
rules.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

rules.effect: Each time another ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit that is not in combat, after that ability has been resolved, if that unit is a **^^Serfs^^** unit, you can return 1 additional slain model to it, and if it is a **^^Knights^^** unit, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Serfs^^** unit that did not charge this turn and is in combat to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that **^^Serfs^^** unit to be the target.
rules.effect: The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
Friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Heroes^^** have **^^Ward (5+)^^** if they have destroyed a unit this battle.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Flesh-eater Courts^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target.

Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.
In addition, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks that target this unit have no effect.

Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, if it did not use a **^^Fight^^** ability in the previous turn. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons instead while this unit has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this battle.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Cadaverous Barricade** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Cadaverous Barricade** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Chalice of Ushoran** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Chalice of Ushoran** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Corpsemare Stampede** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Corpsemare Stampede** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Hero^^** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. You cannot pick **Nagash** to be the target of this prayer.

Pick 1 of the following runes to depict on your **battle scripture**. The effect and conditional **enhanced** effects of that rune last for the rest of the battle round. Each rune remains on your **battle scripture** for the rest of the battle or until it is removed or replaced by another ability.
**Varinor, Rune of Strength**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for each target. In addition, the following **enhanced** effects apply:
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 1 to wound rolls for each target's combat attacks.
• While **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can use **^^Shoot^^** and/or **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.
**Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Each target has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. In addition, the following **enhanced** effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, the targets' melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**,subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets.
**Ydriliqi, Rune of the River**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of any of the targets. In addition, the following **enhanced** effects apply:
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by the targets.
• If **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can immediately move 3". They can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
**Oreali, Rune of the Wind**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets. In addition, the following **enhanced** effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 4" to each target's Move characteristic.
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 5 to each target's control score.
**Thalari, Rune of the Zenith**: Add 2 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units. In addition, if you have 4 or more unique runes depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 4" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units and friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units' attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
**Designer's Note**: *We recommend noting the runes you have inscribed in each battle round on a piece of paper to keep track of which are currently depicted on your **battle scripture**. Feel free to note them by type (Strength, River, Mountain etc.), by initial (each has a different first letter) or if you are feeling particularly adventurous, you can try your hand at aelven calligraphy and learn to draw each rune!*

rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets that friendly unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

rules.effect: Inflict D3+X mortal damage on the target, where X is the number of times, to a maximum of 3, that this spell has previously been successfully cast by a friendly **^^Wizard^^** this turn.

When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with this unit, each time your opponent would spend **rage dice** as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability, they must spend 1 additional **rage dice**.

You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more enemy units were destroyed this turn and you control the enemy **hideout**.

Affray — Form a Wall:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units are wholly outside friendly territory, wholly within 6" of friendly territory and within 3" of each other.

Strike — Outpost Territory:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective within enemy territory and that objective is contested by:
• At least 1 friendly unit that did not use a **^^Move^^** ability this turn
• At least 1 other friendly unit that charged this turn.

Domination — Repel the Attackers:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 3 or more friendly units within 3" of the centre of the battlefield that are not in combat.

Card — At the start of the battle, after using all Deployment Phase abilities but before determining which player will take the first turn, pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** on the battlefield or in reserve to be the **fugitive** for the rest of the battle.

Affray — Search Every Inch:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there is a different friendly unit wholly within each large quarter of the battlefield, those friendly units are more than 9" from the centre of the battlefield, and no more than 1 of those friendly units was set up this turn.

Strike — Quick Pursuit:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 1 of the following is true:
• There are 3 or more friendly units that are not in combat and are within 12" of the enemy **fugitive**.
• There is no enemy **fugitive** on the battlefield.

Domination — Bring Them In:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 1 of the following is true:
• There are 3 or more friendly units in combat with the enemy **fugitive**.
• There is no enemy **fugitive** on the battlefield and 3 or more friendly units are contesting the same objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

Affray — Daring Rescue:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if an enemy unit that was in combat at the start of the turn was destroyed by a combat attack made by a friendly unit that charged this turn.

Strike — Command from the Front:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 2 or more friendly **^^Heroes^^** on the battlefield, all friendly **^^Heroes^^** are within 9" of a visible enemy unit and no friendly **^^Heroes^^** were slain this turn.

Domination — Hero of Legend:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective wholly outside your territory that you did not control at the start of the turn and a friendly **^^Hero^^** is contesting that objective.

Affray — Ambuscade:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more objectives or terrain features that you control, in any combination, are each contested by a different friendly unit that is more than 6" from friendly territory and was not set up this turn.

Strike — Surround the Enemy:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units that were not set up this turn are each within 9" of a different corner of the battlefield and wholly outside friendly territory.

Domination — Claim What's Yours:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are more friendly units within enemy territory than enemy units and there is at least 1 friendly **^^Hero^^** wholly within enemy territory.

Affray — Keep the Enemy Close:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective that is contested by at least 1 enemy unit.

Strike — Feign Weakness:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if more friendly units were destroyed this turn than enemy units.

Domination — Execute the Plan:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control each objective within enemy territory.
If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack scores 2 hits on the target instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit.

Unless otherwise specified, attacks made by this weapon are not affected by friendly abilities that modify hit rolls, wound rolls or weapon characteristics, except for those that apply negative modifiers (e.g. 'Covering Fire')

Add 1 to this weapon's Rend characteristic if the target has the keyword after 'Anti-' or fulfils the condition after 'Anti-'. Multiples of this ability are cumulative. For example, if a weapon has both Anti-charge (+1 Rend) and Anti-HERO (+1 Rend), then add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the weapon for attacks that target a HERO that charged in the same turn.
Add 1 to this weapon's Damage characteristic if the attacking unit charged this turn
If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack automatically wounds the target. Make a save roll as normal.
If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack inflicts mortal damage on the target unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that weapon and the attack sequence ends.
This weapon can be used to make shooting attacks even if the attacking unit is in combat.
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit charged this turn or has the **^^Fly^^** keyword.
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.
A unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless it has the **^^Fly^^** keyword.
**^^Heroes^^** within 3" of this terrain feature can use the 'Activate Place of Power' ability.
Models can move across but cannot be set up on or end any type of move on any part of this terrain feature that is more than 1" tall.
